title: About the hub
text:
The Swedish Influenza Forecast Hub is a research pilot at the Department of Mathematical Sciences, Chalmers University of Technology.
Its purpose is to make independent influenza forecasts comparable, evaluate them openly and investigate whether a probabilistic ensemble provides more robust decision support than individual models.

title: About the hub
text:
Data source
Observed data are retrieved from the Public Health Agency of Sweden’s Folkhälsodata database. The retrospective view uses the frozen final version for the 2025/26 season.

title: About the hub
text:
Openness
The formats, validation tools, test models, ensemble code and evaluation results are available in the hub’s GitHub repository.

title: Om hubben
text:
Nationella prognoshubben för influensa är en forskningspilot vid Institutionen för matematiska vetenskaper, Chalmers tekniska högskola.
Syftet är att göra oberoende influensaprognoser jämförbara, utvärdera dem öppet och undersöka om en probabilistisk ensemble ger ett robustare beslutsunderlag än enskilda modeller.

title: Modeller
text:
Enskilda punktmodeller
Den retrospektiva vyn innehåller alla modeller som har lämnat en fullständig prognosserie för 2025/26: hubbens permanenta testmodeller samt deltagarnas modeller. Den aktuella vyn visar de modeller som har publicerat prognoser för 2026/27.

gerlee-history
En adaptiv historisk regressionsmodell. Veckans förväntade antal fall skrivs som en icke-negativ linjär kombination av motsvarande veckor under tidigare säsonger. Vikterna uppdateras under säsongen med gemensam regularisering \(\lambda=1\).
Modellerna kan jämföras i den retrospektiva vyn och i vyn för aktuell säsong. Fullständiga metadata finns i model-metadata-katalogen. Koden för gerlee-history finns i dess modellrepository.

title: Evaluation 2025/26
text:
The results refer to retrospective forecasts for the 2025/26 season.
The probabilistic evaluation compares the QRA ensemble with the probabilistic baseline model. Lower WIS is better. WIS skill above zero means that the QRA improves on the baseline; a value below zero means that the baseline performs better.
Coverage rates for the 50%, 80% and 95% intervals are available in the complete results file on GitHub.

title: Evaluation 2025/26
text:
Interpretation
WIS rewards accurate forecasts while also penalising unnecessarily wide prediction intervals. A separate metric for interval width is therefore not required. Results from a single retrospective season should be interpreted cautiously and do not, by themselves, demonstrate general model performance.

title: Utvärdering 2025/26
text:
Resultaten avser retrospektiva prognoser för säsongen 2025/26.
Den probabilistiska utvärderingen jämför QRA-ensemblen med den probabilistiska baseline-modellen. Lägre WIS är bättre. WIS-färdighet över noll betyder att QRA förbättrar baseline; ett värde under noll betyder att baseline är bättre.
Täckningsgraderna för 50 %, 80 % och 95 % finns i den fullständiga resultatfilen på GitHub.

title: Utvärdering 2025/26
text:
Tolkning
WIS belönar träffsäkra prognoser men bestraffar samtidigt onödigt breda prognosintervall. Därför behövs ingen separat metrik för intervallbredd. Resultaten från en enskild retrospektiv säsong ska tolkas försiktigt och är inte i sig belägg för generell modellprestanda.

Comparable forecasts

title: Swedish Influenza Forecast Hub
text:
What is shown?

Individual models: point forecasts from the models included in the hub.
QRA ensemble: a regularised probabilistic ensemble of the available models.
Probabilistic baseline: a three-week moving average with uncertainty estimated from historical data.
Observed data: frozen weekly values from the Public Health Agency of Sweden’s Folkhälsodata database.

The hub is a research pilot run by the Department of Mathematical Sciences at Chalmers University of Technology.

title: Models
text:
A regularised quantile regression averaging ensemble. It is estimated separately for each location, forecast horizon and quantile. Regularisation is selected using time-ordered expanding-window validation.



A probabilistic baseline. Its mean is the average of the three most recent observations. Uncertainty is represented by a normal distribution whose standard deviation is estimated from historical rolling-origin errors, separately for each location and horizon.

title: Models
text:
A regularised quantile regression averaging ensemble. It is estimated separately for each location, forecast horizon and quantile. Regularisation is selected using time-ordered expanding-window validation.



A probabilistic baseline. Its mean is the average of the three most recent observations. Uncertainty is represented by a normal distribution whose standard deviation is estimated from historical rolling-origin errors, separately for each location and horizon.

title: Models
text:
Individual point models
The retrospective view includes all models that submitted a complete forecast series for 2025/26: the hub’s permanent test models and the participating teams’ models. The current view presents models that have published forecasts for 2026/27.

gerlee-history
An adaptive historical-season regression model. The expected number of cases in a given week is represented as a non-negative linear combination of the corresponding weeks in previous seasons. The weights are updated during the season using shared regularisation with \(\lambda=1\).
The models can be compared in the retrospective view and the current-season view. Complete metadata are available in the model-metadata directory. The code for gerlee-history is available in its model repository.

title: Nationella prognoshubben för influensa
text:
Vad visas?

Enskilda modeller: punktprognoser från de modeller som ingår i hubben.
QRA-ensemble: en regulariserad probabilistisk ensemble av tillgängliga modeller.
Probabilistisk baseline: ett treveckors glidande medelvärde med historiskt skattad osäkerhet.
Utfall: frysta veckovärden från Folkhälsomyndighetens Folkhälsodata.

Hubben är en forskningspilot som drivs av Institutionen för matematiska vetenskaper vid Chalmers tekniska högskola.
